meta.name: background-job-processing
meta.description: Implement background job processing systems with task queues, workers, scheduling, and retry mechanisms. Use when handling long-running tasks, sending emails, generating reports, and processing large datasets asynchronously.

copy.tagline: 异步处理耗时任务，提升系统响应速度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在后台处理耗时操作而不阻塞用户请求
copy.tagline_en: Process long-running tasks asynchronously to improve responsiveness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle time-consuming operations in the background without blocking user requests

howto.what: Claude会帮你设计和生成后台作业处理系统的代码与配置，包括任务队列、工作线程、调度和重试机制，实现异步任务执行。
howto.when: 当用户需要异步处理长时间运行的任务、发送邮件、生成报告或处理大数据集时触发。

say.text: 帮我用Python和Celery设置后台作业队列
用Node.js和Bull队列实现邮件发送后台任务

howto.what_en: Claude helps design and generate code and configurations for background job processing systems, including task queues, workers, scheduling, and retry mechanisms for async execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user needs to handle long-running tasks, send emails, generate reports, or process large datasets asynchronously.

say_en.text: Set up a background job queue with Python and Celery
say_en.note: Claude will generate Celery configuration code

say_en.text: Implement email sending as a background task using Node.js and Bull queue
say_en.note: Claude will provide Bull queue implementation

say_en.text: Add exponential backoff retry strategy to this task
say_en.note: Claude will modify task retry logic
